reviews.decision_reason: The unit selects all corpus rows as demand-bearing, but the supplied package only shows need text plus scores/weights. It does not expose observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes needed to validate market demand, so demand-bearing selection cannot be trusted under the strict criteria.

Given the selected needs shown in the supplied package, this unit appears to retain the existing record identifiers and preserve the bounded sequence of normalized records without visible contradiction.

The evidence source handoff records are assembled deterministically from the normalized records and preserve record_id/source_id/source_weight with ranks matching the supplied upstream output. This does not independently validate demand, but the handoff assembly itself is consistent with its declared role.
